# semaphore_ex_project_notification_destination_test (Action)

Queues a real test notification for the selected destination. The dispatcher may deliver it asynchronously. Executes only through explicit Action invocation. Progress reports a bounded, non-secret summary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_project_notification_destination_test" "example" {
  config {
    project_id     = 1
    destination_id = 2
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_project_notification_destination_test.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_id` (Number)
- `project_id` (Number)
